act.title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/2453 of 30 November 2022 amending the implementing technical standards laid down in Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/637 as regards the disclosure of environmental, social and governance risks

legal_basis.article: Article 18a of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/637 (inserted by Article 1(1) of Implementing Regulation (EU) 2022/2453)
legal_basis.templates_in: Annex XXXIX to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/637 (Annex I to Regulation (EU) 2022/2453), OJ L 324, 19.12.2022, pp. 5-15
legal_basis.instructions_in: Annex XL to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/637 (Annex II to Regulation (EU) 2022/2453), OJ L 324, 19.12.2022, pp. 16 ff.
legal_basis.quote: Institutions shall disclose the information referred to in Article 449a of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 as follows:

applies.quote: Unless indicated otherwise in the instructions set out in Annex XL to this Regulation, institutions shall, as of 31 December 2022, disclose the information referred to in Article 449a of Regulation (EU) No 575/2013 on the following dates:
applies.until_quote: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/637 shall cease to apply from 1 January 2025 (Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/3172, Article 27(1))

templates.title: Table 1 - Qualitative information on Environmental risk

rows.label: Business strategy and processes

Business strategy and processes > Institution's business strategy to integrate environmental factors and risks, taking into account the impact of environmental factors and risks on institution's business environment, business model, strategy and financial planning

Business strategy and processes > Objectives, targets and limits to assess and address environmental risk in short-, medium-, and long-term, and performance assessment against these objectives, targets and limits, including forward-looking information about the design of business strategy and processes
Business strategy and processes > Current investment activities and (future) investment targets towards environmental objectives and EU Taxonomy-aligned activities
Business strategy and processes > Policies and procedures relating to direct and indirect engagement with new or existing counterparties on their strategies to mitigate and reduce environmental risks
Governance

Governance > Responsibilities of the management body for setting the risk framework, supervising and managing the implementation of the objectives, strategy and policies in the context of environmental risk management covering relevant transmission channels

Governance > Management body's integration of short-, medium- and long-term effects of environmental factors and risks, organisational structure both within business lines and internal control functions

Governance > Integration of measures to manage environmental factors and risks in internal governance arrangements, including the role of committees, the allocation of tasks and responsibilities, and the feedback loop from risk management to the management body covering relevant transmission channels
Governance > Lines of reporting and frequency of reporting relating to environmental risk
Governance > Alignment of the remuneration policy with institution's environmental risk-related objectives
Risk management
Risk management > Integration of short-, medium- and long-term effects of environmental factors and risks in the risk framework
Risk management > Definitions, methodologies and international standards on which the environmental risk management framework is based
Risk management > Processes to identify, measure and monitor activities and exposures (and collateral where applicable) sensitive to environmental risks, covering relevant transmission channels
Risk management > Activities, commitments and exposures contributing to mitigate environmental risks
Risk management > Implementation of tools for identification, measurement and management of environmental risks
Risk management > Results and outcome of the risk tools implemented and the estimated impact of environmental risk on capital and liquidity risk profile
Risk management > Data availability, quality and accuracy, and efforts to improve these aspects
Risk management > Description of limits to environmental risks (as drivers of prudential risks) that are set, and triggering escalation and exclusion in the case of breaching these limits

Risk management > Description of the link (transmission channels) between environmental risks with credit risk, liquidity and funding risk, market risk, operational risk and reputational risk in the risk management framework

templates.title: Table 2 - Qualitative information on Social risk

rows.label: Business strategy and processes

Business strategy and processes > Adjustment of the institution's business strategy to integrate social factors and risks taking into account the impact of social risk on the institution's business environment, business model, strategy and financial planning

Business strategy and processes > Objectives, targets and limits to assess and address social risk in short-term, medium-term and long-term, and performance assessment against these objectives, targets and limits, including forward-looking information in the design of business strategy and processes

Business strategy and processes > Policies and procedures relating to direct and indirect engagement with new or existing counterparties on their strategies to mitigate and reduce socially harmful activities
Governance

Governance > Responsibilities of the management body for setting the risk framework, supervising and managing the implementation of the objectives, strategy and policies in the context of social risk management covering counterparties' approaches to:

Responsibilities of the management body for setting the risk framework, supervising and managing the implementation of the objectives, strategy and policies in the context of social risk management covering counterparties' approaches to: > Activities towards the community and society

Responsibilities of the management body for setting the risk framework, supervising and managing the implementation of the objectives, strategy and policies in the context of social risk management covering counterparties' approaches to: > Employee relationships and labour standards

Responsibilities of the management body for setting the risk framework, supervising and managing the implementation of the objectives, strategy and policies in the context of social risk management covering counterparties' approaches to: > Customer protection and product responsibility

Responsibilities of the management body for setting the risk framework, supervising and managing the implementation of the objectives, strategy and policies in the context of social risk management covering counterparties' approaches to: > Human rights

Governance > Integration of measures to manage social factors and risks in internal governance arrangements, including the role of committees, the allocation of tasks and responsibilities, and the feedback loop from risk management to the management body
Governance > Lines of reporting and frequency of reporting relating to social risk
Governance > Alignment of the remuneration policy in line with institution's social risk-related objectives
Risk management
Risk management > Definitions, methodologies and international standards on which the social risk management framework is based
Risk management > Processes to identify, measure and monitor activities and exposures (and collateral where applicable) sensitive to social risk, covering relevant transmission channels
Risk management > Activities, commitments and assets contributing to mitigate social risk
Risk management > Implementation of tools for identification and management of social risk
Risk management > Description of setting limits to social risk and cases to trigger escalation and exclusion in the case of breaching these limits

Risk management > Description of the link (transmission channels) between social risks with credit risk, liquidity and funding risk, market risk, operational risk and reputational risk in the risk management framework

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 1, point 1(a)
instructions.quote: institutions shall disclose information on their exposures towards non-financial corporates operating in carbon-related sectors, and on the quality of those exposures, including non-performing status, stage 2 classification, and related provisions as well as maturity buckets;

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 1, point 1(b)
instructions.quote: Institutions shall start disclosing information in columns (i) to (k) of the template with first disclosure reference date as of 30 June 2024.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 1, point 3
instructions.quote: Institutions shall include in the rows of the template the breakdown of the gross carrying amount of loans and advances, debt securities and equity instruments to non-financial corporations, other than those held for trading, by sector of economic activities

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 1, point 3

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 1, point 4
instructions.quote: The counterparty NACE sector allocation shall be based on the nature of the direct counterparty.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 1, point 4
instructions.quote: The classification of the exposures incurred jointly by more than one obligor shall be based on the characteristics of the obligor that was the more relevant, or determinant, for the institution to grant the exposure.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 1, column a
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount, referred to in Part 1 of Annex V to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/451, of those exposures towards non-financial corporates, including loans and advances, debt securities and equity instruments,

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 1, column c
instructions.quote: Institutions shall start disclosing that information in 2024, with first disclosure reference date as of 31 December 2023, for exposures included in the numerator of the GAR.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 1, column i
instructions.quote: The disclosure covers all sectors and subsectors that highly contribute to climate change, including the oil, gas, mining and transportation sectors,

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 1, columns l–p

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 5, column a
instructions.quote: These geographical areas include the countries or other geographical or administrative regions where the counterparty’s activities or the collateral are located, and which are exposed to chronic or acute climate-change events.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 5, column a
instructions.quote: For geographical coverage of the exposures, institutions shall use the level of divisions indicated in Nomenclature of Territorial Units for Statistics (or NUTS), as appropriate.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 5, column b
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount as defined in Part 1 of Annex V to Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/451 of those exposures towards non-financial corporates (including loans and advances, debt securities and equity instruments),

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 5, columns c–o
instructions.quote: The gross carrying amount of exposures prone to impact from climate change physical events may be equal to the full exposure amount disclosed in column (b) of this template or may be a part of that exposure amount.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 5, column h
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount of exposures sensitive to impact from chronic climate-change events only, including hazards relating to gradual changes in weather and climate and having a possible impact on economic output and productivity.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 5, column i
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount of exposures sensitive to impact from acute climate change events only, including hazards that may cause sudden damage to properties, disruption of supply chains, and depreciation of assets.

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 5, column j
instructions.quote: Institutions shall disclose the gross carrying amount subject to impact from both chronic and acute climate change events, referred to in columns (h) and (i).

instructions.ref: Annex XL, Template 5, columns c–g
instructions.quote: where an exposure has no stated maturity for reasons other than the counterparty having the choice of the repayment date, the amount of this exposure shall be disclosed in column ‘> 20 years’;

interpretations.subject: T5 rows
interpretations.reading: Rows 1-9 and 13 hold exposures towards non-financial corporations by the counterparty's NACE section (13 = sections other than A-H and L). Rows 10-12 hold loans collateralised by residential / commercial immovable property and repossessed collateral, whatever the counterparty. They are separate populations, not 'of which' rows: an exposure to a non-financial corporation collateralised by immovable property appears in its sector row and in row 10 or 11. The template has no total row.
interpretations.basis: Annex XL, Template 5, point 2 names three populations: exposures 'towards non-financial corporates', 'loans collateralized with immovable property' and 'repossessed real estate collaterals'; column b limits the gross carrying amount to exposures towards non-financial corporates. EBA/ITS/2026/02 (EU CRFR2, Part 1 para 25 b-c) states the same split explicitly for the successor template.

interpretations.subject: T1 rows 1 and 53
interpretations.reading: Row 1 is the subtotal of the section rows printed under it (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, L); row 53 is the subtotal of rows 54 (K) and 55 (J, M–U); row 56 (TOTAL) is rows 1 + 53. Division, group and class rows (e.g. B.05, D35.11) are 'of which' rows of their section and are not added again.
interpretations.basis: The printed template places 'I - Accommodation and food service activities' between H and L inside the row-1 group, while Annex XL, Template 1, point 3 names Sections A to H and L as the sectors that highly contribute to climate change. The template's own layout is followed so that its rows add up; the difference is Section I only.

interpretations.subject: T7 rows 32, 45, 49, 50
interpretations.reading: Row 32 (TOTAL GAR ASSETS) equals row 1, the assets covered in both numerator and denominator. Row 45 adds the assets covered in the denominator only (rows 33, 37, 41-44) to row 32. Row 49 adds rows 46-48. Row 50 (TOTAL ASSETS) is every asset in the book: where an asset's facts do not yet place it in a row, it is still counted here, and the form states the amount not yet classified. Template 9.1 row 1 is Template 7 row 32 and row 19 is Template 7 row 50. Flows (Template 8 / 9.2 columns q-af) take the exposures originated in the reporting year at their current balance.
interpretations.basis: The template prints these as totals of the rows above them without a formula in Annex XL; Annex XL, Template 9.1 row 1 reads 'As disclosed in row 32 of template 7'; Template 8 column q says new assets are 'net of repayments and other reductions', which the current balance of a loan originated in the year reflects.
